subject.title: fix(gateway): session workspace reveal hangs on foreground opener

question: Which open PR should become the canonical platform-opener lifecycle implementation: this shared helper covering both config opening and workspace reveal, or the config-only implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109126?
rationale: Both branches solve the same launcher-lifetime problem but deliberately place the policy at different ownership boundaries; choosing the permanent shared contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the shared opener
options.body: Merge this PR if maintainers want one tested gateway launcher lifecycle for both existing callers, then reconcile or close the config-only proposal.

options.title: Keep config-specific ownership
options.body: Prefer the config-only proposal if config error classification must remain coupled to its launcher lifecycle, then add a separate bounded solution for workspace reveal.

options.title: Request a reconciled successor
options.body: Pause both branches and ask for one focused PR that combines the chosen lifecycle with explicit coverage for both RPC callers.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared opener
recommendation.body: Merge this PR if maintainers want one tested gateway launcher lifecycle for both existing callers, then reconcile or close the config-only proposal.

likelyOwner.reason: The active PR assignment provides the clearest available routing signal for the canonical-design choice.
